title: Stable Rank 连续触发次数

standard.summary: 连续多少步 stable rank 低于崩溃阈值才触发干预。默认 10。
standard.effect: 防止偶发 SVD 数值波动误触发干预，要求持续崩溃才响应。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 10 适合大多数场景。
standard.avoidWhen: 不使用 stable rank 监控时此参数无意义。

standard_en.summary: How many consecutive steps the stable rank must sit below the collapse threshold before an intervention fires. Default 10.
standard_en.effect: Keeps occasional SVD numerical noise from triggering an intervention -- only a sustained collapse gets a response.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Meaningless when stable-rank monitoring is not in use.

advanced.principle: 维护连续低于阈值计数器，达到后触发干预（通常为降 LR 或告警）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 值越大，检测到真实崩溃的延迟越长；值越小，偶发波动越容易误触发。

advanced_en.principle: Maintains a consecutive-below-threshold counter; once reached, triggers intervention (usually lowering LR or raising an alert).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Larger values delay detecting a genuine collapse; smaller values false-trigger on sporadic fluctuation.
